closureRuleReading: EXACT_ONLY: no optional member, no interpretable member, no implicit extension, no at-minimum reading
readingPrinciple: The FeatureRecordId identifies the question asked, never the answer; status, value and vectorStatus are therefore excluded, which is the GATE23 generalization of the GATE22 identity rule.
formulaIdRule: FormulaId is behaviour; a behavioural change produces a new FormulaId and therefore a new FeatureRecordId.
instrumentIdentityRule: InstrumentIdentityId is the single canonical source of instrument identity; ticker is not identity.
missingnessInIdentityRule: MissingnessStateId is a declared state of the observed window, not an answer, and is therefore an identity member.
replayRule: Identical inputs replay to an identical FeatureRecordId; any drift in a single member moves the identity.
